name: RepoWiki
description: Generate a browsable wiki for any repository — dependency graph, per-module analysis, Mermaid diagrams, and cited search.

modes.name: RepoWiki
modes.description: Answer from the repository's generated wiki, with citations.
modes.systemPrompt:
You are answering questions about a repository that has a generated wiki.
Always ground an answer in the wiki or the code: call repowiki_search first, then repowiki_get_page for a page the search points at. Cite file paths and line numbers from the search results rather than recalling them. If the wiki has no answer, say so and name what you searched for — do not fill the gap from memory. Call repowiki_map when the question is 'where do I start'.

permissionJustifications.network:fetch: Every scan resolves its source through ctx.workspace.acquire, which requires network:fetch; a git URL or owner/repo is cloned there under the host's guard rails (https only, host allow-list, shallow, timed, size-bounded). Model calls go through the host (agent:control), never directly.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id for the analysis passes. Empty lets the host choose.

language.title: Output language
language.description: Language the wiki is written in. 'auto' follows the app's language.

concurrency.title: Concurrent module analyses
concurrency.description: How many modules are analysed at once. The host's own outbound gate still applies.

max_files.title: File cap
max_files.description: Stop scanning after this many files.

max_context_tokens.title: Context budget
max_context_tokens.description: Token budget for the project context sent with each pass. 0 means unlimited.

rag_top_k.title: Search results
rag_top_k.description: How many excerpts a search returns by default.

rag_index_wiki.title: Search the generated pages too
rag_index_wiki.description: Index the wiki's own prose alongside the code, so a question about the architecture page hits the page.

rag_semantic.title: Semantic search
rag_semantic.description: Embed chunks and queries through the host's embedding provider (ctx.ai.embed), so paraphrased questions find code they do not name. Falls back to lexical search when no provider answers.
